$Comment: The Heartwinder's fight, HARD MODE (DESIGN.md 7; notes/boss.md "Hard mode"). It runs only while its flag Hard_Mode is true; the selector by B2's south door sets that flag in both encounters (its beacons are heard only while no fight is live, so the choice locks when the boss wakes). Waiting: when a player comes near, it spawns the boss dormant in its cradle. The boss wakes when a player steps onto the inner floor and tells this encounter, which seals the door, shows the bar and starts the music; the intro ends with a beacon and the phases follow: Phase1 -> Transition1 at 70% -> Phase2 -> Overwound at 50% (a second spike, then Phase2b, faster) -> Transition2 at 35% -> Phase3 -> Overwind at 12% (a countdown by party size; four brakes seize it, midnight chimes) -> Dead (the vault opens) -> Complete. A wipe, an empty arena for 10 s or the restart beacon resets everything (vanilla Encounter_Macro_Reset_Arena). Built by tools/models/heartworks/heartwinder.npc.encounter.mjs.
